text: Median salaries per employee gender (current salary records with to_date = '9999-01-01')

metadata.query: WITH current_salaries AS (SELECT e.gender, s.salary FROM employees e JOIN salaries s ON s.emp_no = e.emp_no WHERE s.to_date = '9999-01-01'), ranked_salaries AS (SELECT gender, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY salary) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS cnt FROM current_salaries) SELECT gender, AVG(salary) AS median_salary FROM ranked_salaries WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), FLOOR((cnt + 2) / 2)) GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender;
metadata.dashboard_description: Median current salaries by employee gender, using salary records with to_date = '9999-01-01'.
